text: I feel hopeless lately and I can’t imagine things ever getting better.
I’ve stopped answering calls and I don’t see the point of anything anymore.
Nobody would even notice if I disappeared. I just want the pain to stop.
I feel hopeless about getting this visa approved, but my lawyer says we have options.
My team lost the final and I feel hopeless about next season, but I’ll be back at practice on Monday.
I’m overwhelmed by exams and a bit down, but talking to my friends helped tonight.
There’s no point carrying an umbrella today, the forecast is clear.
I’m so happy today. Everything feels possible and I can’t wait for tomorrow.
